description: Calculate Portuguese car import tax (ISV, Imposto Sobre Veículos) using the official Portuguese formula (engine-cc + CO₂ components, with age reduction for used cars) — accurate to the cent vs the AT (Finanças) simulator. Needs engine displacement (cc), CO₂ (g/km, WLTP), fuel and registration year. The result is exact for those inputs; the final amount depends only on the exact CO₂/cc on the car's COC document.

fuel.description: Fuel: petrol, diesel, hybrid, phev, electric
